title: Chusky has been upgraded
bullets: Added Monid and Treg research planners: reusable SEO, ads, extraction, company/account research, people and lead enrichment/discovery, buying signals, hiring, technology, market maps, and general research; endpoints stay live-discovered.

Muna uses the matching research playbook and executes through existing approval, spend-reservation, account-scope, and async/pending-call controls; campaigns and recurring watches use Chusky's durable workflows.
Both planners make no provider calls and cannot authorize spend; data-quality, privacy, and Treg/Monid configuration boundaries remain active.
